{{Quote|You failed to see what was right before your eyes. Darth Nul was no Child of the Emperor. She was the first. The Mother of them all. Darth Nul created the Children of the Emperor. She hunted the quarry, broke them. Indoctrinated them. His power, his will, but her methods, her inventions&hellip; until the Emperor no longer found her useful|Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR:DD" />}}
'''Darth Nul''', born '''Raniah''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] whose records were erased from history by the time of the [[third Galactic War]]. She was the co-creator of the [[Children of the Emperor]] alongside the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].

==Biography==
===Jedi===
{{Quote|In those who did not recognize their own abilities, she awakened that realization. She was looked down upon for this, by those who believed she shared power with the unworthy. She could find no favor among her kind. Darth Nul took those who would follow her to an empty world in Wild Space where they could do as they pleased, without judgment. Nul taught her disciples how to forge mental bonds as she did. They called out to others and invited them to their sanctuary.|[[Sana-Rae]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:OW" />}}
The [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] individual who became [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nul was born centuries before the [[Great Galactic War]] as "Raniah", a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Despite her rank, she roused uneasiness from other Jedi mainly due to her unorthodox beliefs regarding the Force, especially her belief that anyone who could feel the Force deserved to be trained in its use.<ref name="TOR:DN" />

[[File:Raniah_captured.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Raniah and her adepts were captured by the Sith]]
Raniah was able to locate other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]s using an unknown technique involving mental connections which not only earned the praise of several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]s, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]s, and even a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] but also suspicion from the rest of the Order. This distrust eventually prompted the Council to expel Raniah and her followers from the Order with the purpose of not allowing her ideas to continue, having deemed them to be “dangerous”.<ref name="TOR:DN" />

[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exiled]], Raniah and her followers took refuge on an uninhabited [[Unidentified Wild Space planet|planet]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. There, the former Jedi Master and her adepts were free to experiment with their own philosophy of the Force and Raniah taught her disciples how to create Force bonds. Through mental connections forged with other Force-sensitives throughout the galaxy, they recruited new adepts and invited them to join their Wild Space sanctuary.<ref name="TOR:OW" /> Unfortunately, Raniah later mistakenly made contact with the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor Vitiate]] through the Force which she found that she could not withstand the Emperor's formidable power to dominate minds and ended with Raniah and her followers being pursued, captured, and enslaved.<ref name="TOR:DN" />

===Sith===
{{Quote|Nul made a connection with someone she did not intend. A being of dark malevolence... the Sith Emperor. He hunted her down, using her own power against her. Before the Emperor could reach her followers, Nul locked many of their secrets away, in the ruins my team discovered. Nul and the others fought back against their captors, but their fate was sealed. The emperor dominated the minds of her disciples, bent them to his will--enslaved them. After that day, Nul's followers became Servants of the Emperor, and she... became Darth Nul.|Sana-Rae, to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="TOR:OW" />}}
Raniah, who was now under the Emperor's control, became the Sith Lord Darth Nul, and was responsible for the creating awful mind-control techniques to subjugate and punish enemies of the Sith.<ref name="TOR:DN" />

[[File:Temple_of_Darth_Nul.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Temple of Nul]] on Elom]]
Darth Nul assisted the Emperor in creating the first [[Children of the Emperor]], where she was tasked with locating the subjects and indoctrinating them to unconditionally serve him. Nul's inventions and designs were key to creating a Child and in conjunction with the Emperor's power she succeeded, therefore dubbing her as "the Mother" of the Children.<ref name="TOR:DD" />

[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nul had a [[Temple of Nul|temple]] on the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="TOR:RoN" /> At some point, a relic created by Darth Nul was recovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and stored in a vault inside the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Secrets of the Enclave">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref> Darth Malgus had theorized that with Darth Nul's cunning, she must have had more than one location to house her inventions, aside from the Temple on Elom.<ref name="TOR:DD" />

After an uncertain amount of time, Darth Nul's usefulness to the Emperor came at an end and he purged her existence from the Sith Empire's records.<ref name="TOR:DD" /> It was later revealed that Darth Nul had sought to awaken a connection to the Force in all, rather than the select few, which in turn would collapse the structure of the Jedi and Sith Orders. [[Tenebrae|The Emperor]] had learnt of this and to avoid any disruptions to his future plans he decided to kill Nul but he valued Nul's knowledge so he destroyed her body and placed her mind in a [[Mind prison]] and placed it in one of his most secured vaults in [[Emperor's Fortress|his fortress]].<ref name="Dark Heart"/>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|She has no ornate tomb, there are no statues or grand murals that depict her deeds. She was a scientist, and her story will be told through the designs of her inventions.|[[Talos Drellik]]|<ref name="TOR:DoN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Designs of Nul}}</ref>}}
Sith Lord [[Lana Beniko]] theorized that Nul's erasure from history had been done intentionally by either the [[Dark Council]] or by the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] himself<ref name="TOR:RoN" /> with the latter case being confirmed.<ref name="TOR:DD" />

The Emperor was able to create more Children, who he used to infiltrate the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], acting as his eyes and ears within the enemy's camp for decades, with some attaining prominent ranks within the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]<ref name="Category Ten">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Category Ten|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref> and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Chaos and Harmony">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Chaos and Harmony|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> During the [[Galactic War]], the Children were [[Hunt for the Children|exposed]] to the galaxy with the defeat of the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]] and were left to fend for themselves, with some renouncing their ties to both the Emperor and the Sith.<ref name="The Defector">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|the Abandoned Mining Facility}}</ref>

[[File:Sahar_Kateen_and_Heta_Kol.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Sa'har Kateen]] delivered [[Darth Nul's holocron]] to [[Heta Kol]]]]
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> during the [[third Galactic War]], the rogue Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus]], through unknown means, managed to learn not only about the existence of Darth Nul but her role as "the Mother" of the Children, as well as her unique inventions which Malgus sought for his own plans. Malgus began his plans with [[Mission to the Jedi Enclave|looting]] Nul's relic from the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine<ref name="Secrets of the Enclave" /> before traveling to [[Temple of Nul|Nul's Temple]] on Elom to locate a [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]] which could be used to find "unworthy" Force-sensitive children. Malgus was subsequently [[Mission to Elom|defeated]] by members of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and the Jedi Order, but he secretly left the holocron to be found by the Jedi Padawan [[Sa'har Kateen]].<ref name="TOR:RoN" /> Kateen later offered the holocron to [[Heta Kol]], the leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="TOR:OW" /> Kol quickly realized that she could use the holocron to create an army of Force-sensitive soldiers.<ref name="TOR:DD2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Desperate Defiance|Odessen}}</ref>

After Malgus' capture, the Jedi [[Gnost-Dural]], [[Tau Idair]] and [[Arn Peralun]] went to explore the galaxy to investigate the identity of Darth Nul.<ref name="TOR:OW" /> Meanwhile, the [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Talos Drellik]] was recruited to study Nul's temples and design due to his extensive career in Sith lore.<ref name="TOR:DD" /> After performing an extensive study, Talos found that Nul's devices including the "Regnant" device and the various traps the strike team encountered bear a striking, yet intriguing, similarities to the [[Phobis devices]]<ref name="TOR:DoN" /> which were used to create the [[Dread Masters]]<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|The Dread Masters}}</ref> and the [[Ravager (device)|Ravager]],<ref name="TOR:DoN" /> a device used by the Sith Emperor to painfully extract secrets from his victims mind.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|An Ancient Answer|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Tau Idair finally [[Duel in Darth Nul's archive|discovered]] [[Darth Nul's lightsaber]] in Nul's [[Darth Nul's archive|secret archive]]. The weapon revealed to the Jedi and the Eternal Alliance that Darth Nul had been a Jedi before becoming a Sith. A short time later, [[Sana-Rae]] and [[Arcann]] of the Eternal Alliance found the ruins of Raniah's camp in Wild Space. There, they discovered a [[Hologram/Legends|holorecord]] of the capture of Raniah and her adepts by the Sith, revealing the fate of Master Raniah and her transformation into Darth Nul.<ref name="TOR:OW" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> the Eternal Alliance eventually [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|recovered]] Darth Nul's holocron from the Hidden Chain, destroying in the process the [[Holocron Machine|machine]] created by the Mandalorians to exploit the power of the holocron.<ref name="TOR:Sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|the Hidden Chain Ship}}</ref>

Some time afterwards, a survey team employed by the Eternal Alliance, led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Farrus Belisk]] was dispatched to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to search for the [[Emperor's Fortress]]. Upon discovering its locations, all members of the survey team were killed off one-by-one by seemingly randomly exploding power systems, leading Belisk and his assistant [[Destom Wuff]] to suspect a presence was purposely luring them in deeper. Eventually, the Alliance Commander and Lana Beniko [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|traveled]] to Ilum to investigate the survey team's disappearance, finding records of their exploration. Eventually finding Dr. Belisk's corpse and spotting a [[Computer spike/Legends|data spike]] inserted into the console, they replayed a holorecording of Malgus speaking to someone, discussing his failed [[New Empire]] and his desire to spread chaos across the galaxy. Suddenly, all the corpses began reanimating as well as Imperial battle droids began attacking.<ref name="Dark Heart" />

[[File:Lana_meets_Nul.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Nul meets [[Lana Beniko]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] in [[Darth Nul's mind prison]]]]
The Commander and Beniko fought their way to the Emperor's vault, where they discovered the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Darth Nul's mind prison|mind prison]] at its center. Seeing Nul's holocron react to the device, they reluctantly entered it, and in so doing, discovered the spirit of Darth Nul locked inside. Realizing they were not Malgus, Nul admitted that he found her some time ago and she gave him the knowledge to make her vision of a galaxy where everyone could use the Force and thus fundamentally upend the Jedi and Sith a reality. She then recalled that in exchange for her knowledge, Malgus promised her freedom and concluded that he sent the Commander to be her new vessel.<ref name="Dark Heart" />

Proclaiming she must see her grand plan realized, Nul's form changed from that of a healthy looking [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] to a decrepit looking old woman and fought against the Commander and Beniko, but could not defeat them. In the end, Nul collapsed on the illusory ground as the [[mind prison]] began to collapse and her foes escaped into the outside world just before the Rakatan device exploded, putting Nul out of her misery.<ref name="Dark Heart" />

The Commander was later forced to sneak off Odessen with the holocron after the [[Alliance base]] was put on lockdown by the Republic to follow a set of coordinates sent by [[Darth Jadus]]. The coordinates led to Nul's ancient research vessel, the ''[[Enigma (research vessel)|Engima]]'', where Jadus claimed her holocron's full potential could be unlocked. He also revealed that Heta Kol had recreated Nul's machine, but Malgus intended to seize it from her, having long planned to use it to spread chaos and anarchy, while Jadus planned to hijack it to carve out a dominion of his own through order and fear. Jadus sent the Commander and their [[Darth Rivix|comp]][[Tau Idair|anion]] into the lower levels of the ''Enigma'', where they were forced to deal with two [[artificial intelligence]]s, based on both Raniah and Nul, and reverted the biomes they managed and unintentionally stagnated to force both protocols to go to the ship's mainframes, where they started a ideological war using holodroids against one ago. The Commander brought the holocron to the mainframe and held off both Raniah and Nul's droids long enough for the process to complete. The two intelligences were then merged into Nul's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|personality matrix]].<ref name="Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|[[Enigma (research vessel)]]}}</ref>

The gatekeeper Nul explained that with the holocron's full functionality unlocked, she could control any of Nul's creations as long as it was directly connected to the holocron. Upon learning that the machine on Elom was destroyed, Nul stated that the other strategic planet that could enable Kol's machine to reach billions of sentients was on [[Khar Shian]]. Jadus then appeared and attempted to take the holocron. But as the Commander stood in his way, their companion suddenly incapacitated them and handed the holocron to Jadus. Despite the Commander freeing themself, Jadus managed to delay them long enough to escape with the holocron.<ref name="Enigma" />

==Personality & traits==
As a Jedi, Raniah possessed an unorthodox belief that the Force should be granted to all those that even the Jedi deemed unworthy. Even when she was ostracized from the Jedi Order, she continued to uphold her beliefs. Unfortunately, as she grew her following, she became careless, which ultimately led to the Sith Emperor discovering her, capturing her and turning her to the dark side.<ref name="TOR:DN" />

Under her new Sith persona, Darth Nul developed a twisted reconsideration of her beliefs. In her eyes, both the Jedi and Sith withheld the Force's gifts from the unworthy and that the only way to free the galaxy of their domination was to reawaken the Force in all and destroy both orders permanently. Though having been turned to the dark side by the Emperor, she was not loyal to him as his other servants and only provided for him to keep him distracted from her own work. When she was later imprisoned, her psyche had begun to deteriorate into insanity.<ref name="Dark Heart" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Darth Nul possessed a talent that was unique among her kind. Through the Force, she could connect her mind to another's. Darth Nul could speak to someone's most hidden desires, reach depths of their thoughts they could not reach themselves. Over great distances, she could mentally bond with anyone who could feel the Force.|Sana-Rae, to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="TOR:OW" />}}
[[File:Darth_Nul_Lightsaber.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Darth Nul's lightsaber]]]]
Darth Nul possessed a strong connection with the Force. As a Jedi, she developed her innate gift for [[Force empathy/Legends|Force empathy]] to levels never seen in the Jedi Order. As she mastered this skill, she became able to create [[Force-bond/Legends|Force bonds]] with any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], even over great distances. She was therefore able to [[Receptive Telepathy|actively read a person's deepest thoughts and feel their emotions]]. In addition, she was also able to awaken Force sensation in individuals who ignored or were unaware of their own connection with the Force.<ref name="TOR:OW" /> Later, as a Sith, she intensified her study of the Force and extended her skills to dark motives. She became an expert of [[Mind trick/Legends|mind manipulation]] and developed some of the most treacherous mind-control techniques.<ref name="TOR:DN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Nul was first mentioned in the seventh ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', in [[2019]]<ref name="TOR:Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> and later appeared in the next expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'', in [[2022]].<ref name="TOR:LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref> She was not voiced until the ''Galactic Threads'' arc of ''Legacy of the Sith'', which launched in [[2025]], where she was voiced by [[Samantha Béart]].<ref name="SamInterview">{{TORYouTube|I6Jx8aX99ss|Interview with Samantha Béart (voice of Darth Nul)}}</ref>
